title: Note Plugin End To End
description: Get the 🗒️note plugin working end to end: native check, guest wasm restage (activate-note-react-dev), react dev serve on 6080 (?plugin=note), proven boot (editor windows + panels) and persisted document mutations (addBlock/patchBlocks/ink) through the shell.
note: Ticket bookkeeping manual on disk: repo MCP timed out (2026-09-17). Pattern follows 26/09/16/LAYOUT-PLUGIN-END-TO-END.
summary: The note react playground boots on 6080 and persists document mutations through the shell. Nine faults fixed: playground app pin; args_bridge + command_from_action (every shell action was refused); 26 BatchOnlyPendingRewrite verbs migrated to retained bounded tools (the full contract table already existed as the unused NOTE_AUDITED_* lists); reset_document_effect minted a live envelope just to print the spr (guest trap on the boot setActiveExample) -> store::empty_document_spr plus build_document_store_initialization_job; the bespoke root-scalar-only preparation factory refused every block mutation -> framework bounded_config_store_one_item_preparation_factory (~1700 lines of dead materialization cursors deleted); the canvas spoke note.document with a nested text child record while the framework ink-canvas host requires ink.document with bare paragraphs (canvas always empty); inbound canvas events were keyed by a retired 'mutation' tag and unwrap_or_default, so every gesture silently decoded to nothing; the armed utility was read from the flat active_utility_id (pencil drags ran as select); and the Demo example never loaded (shell sends exampleId 'demo', note matched 'semio', and the demo DSL no longer parsed). Also repaired 15 shared renderer/kernel/actor files a peer's [DEBUG]-strip codemod had corrupted by fusing if/for heads onto the next statement, which 500'd every react serve and silently changed shell action dispatch. Proof: boot + addBlock + undo + panel quick-add + tree selection + Delete + undo + canvas pencil stroke + undo, zero fault lines except the known host setHover gap; descriptor regenerated; native 344 pass / 45 fail, all pre-existing families.
